diagnostics.message: Instance head has the wrong kind for interface 'Graded': the interface's type parameter is graded — kind `Effect -> Type -> Type` — but `Q` has kind `Type -> Type -> Type`, so the grade the methods index by has nowhere to live and every index a caller reads off a result would be fabricated. Give `Q` a parameter used in an effect position at each `Row` slot — a constructor field of the shape `Unit -> <e> a` is what makes a parameter row-kinded — or implement a non-graded interface for it instead.
'impl Alpha ET' is missing method 'abar'. Every interface method without a default body must be implemented — define 'abar' in the impl (or check for a typo in a method name)
'impl Ord GT2' is missing method 'compare'. Every interface method without a default body must be implemented — define 'compare' in the impl (or check for a typo in a method name)
